caption: The same uncut kitchen shot continues smoothly. The same middle-aged chef turns back to face the camera behind the stainless steel counter. His shaved head, thick black eyebrows, close gray beard, deep-set brown eyes, white chef jacket with black buttons, cobalt blue apron, red thermometer on the left chest pocket, and white plate with three basil leaves remain unchanged. Smooth continuous motion, no camera cut, warm restaurant kitchen lighting.
